# S18 — Parse review queue

Admin queue to confirm or correct low-confidence parses and matches; each answer is cached forever (I5).

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:** web

**Not in this slice:** LLM suggestions (Later).

## Why

Rules won't cover everything. Confirming a line once means the same line never needs reviewing again, so the review workload trends toward zero.

## Owner input

1. Queue placement: an admin page with a count badge (recommended)?
2. Confirm in bulk (one tap per line) vs. a full edit form per line?
